summary: Phase 10 feature testing — Smart Repeat Scheduling, Testimonial Auto-Converter, Spanish Mode. All 24 backend pytest cases pass. All frontend data-testid markers present and functional: landing + dashboard language switchers, /app/repeat, /app/testimonials, and /t/consent/{token} public page all render and function correctly. AI polish produced quality Spanish/English testimonial text via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.
critical_code_review_comments: testimonials.py start_testimonial_flow uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL as frontend_base (that env var is really the backend/public preview URL — it happens to work here because frontend and backend share the same preview host, but semantically it should be FRONTEND_URL from backend/.env). Non-blocking.
cron/repeat-reminders dispatches work via asyncio.create_task without a retry/dead-letter — acceptable for log-mode but worth noting.

testimonials consent idempotency relies on review_id — if the review hook is called with an empty id (fallback to token) collisions are theoretically possible across tenants, but tenant_id scope mitigates this.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create and clean up TEST_ prefixed repeat schedules and testimonials; one consent testimonial for 'TEST_Consent' remains in DB after UI verification (consent_token 44e9e1f5-...)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 10 (3 features) fully verified. Use /app/backend/tests/test_phase10_new_features.py as regression. Note demo/turn endpoint expects field name 'text' (not 'message').
